context: Request: which associates have patent-litigation experience (staffing a new patent case). Rubric: five associates (Christy Bauer, Omar Siddiqui, Peter Vassiliev, Wendy Schultz, Priya Subramaniam), each grounded in a qualifying matter (judge cites 1014-00003, 1014-00004 and an active patent-enforcement matter), plus a precision criterion. The rubric lists no matter numbers, so hindsight values treat the matters cited by the judge as the needed ones.

first_error.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script

divergence: All three runs failed at search: none reached the matters of two associates (T1 reached none). T0 relied on content greps whose hits came from email text, T2 on one store-wide scan that timed out, and T1's scan output filled the context and ended the run without a response.
